Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
package Problems_On_Number;

public class PrimeNumbersInRange {
    public static boolean isPrime(int num) {
        if (num == 1)
            return false;
        for (int i = 2; i < Math.sqrt(num); i++) {
            if (num % i == 0)
                return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void PrintPrimesbwrange(int a, int b) {
        for (int i = a; i <= b; i++) {
            if (isPrime(i)) {
                System.out.print(i + " ");
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String args[]) {
        int a = 10, b = 17;
        PrintPrimesbwrange(a, b);
    }
}
